neighbours.label: Commas and connecting words inside a formal English list of specialist terms (academic fields or courses, drug names, medical specialties), e.g. a curriculum, a clinical treatment list or a services list. Quiet for lists of everyday things (fruit, groceries, car parts, common symptoms), for the same specialist list in a casual chatty voice, for jargon sentences that are not lists, and for such lists in other languages. Weaker (about 0.2-0.4) on scholarly reference-list entries.
neighbours.short: commas in formal lists of specialist terms
neighbours.notes: Step-in reader of bonsai1/L33/N3279+ (drop 0.18). Feeders-first arm: strongest feeders are topic cells (L31/N10782+ antibiotics/penicillin, L31/N2981+ oil industry). Pole is broad (7.9% of tokens at 0.1 max). Test written blind by a label-only author.
